data.one_liner: Type-safe unit conversion and measurement library for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe unit conversion, measurement calculations, and locale-aware formatting across 30+ physical quantity categories. Includes support for linear, affine, inverse, and logarithmic quantities with compile-time safety and scientific constants.
use_when: Building scientific, engineering, or fitness apps requiring accurate unit conversions
Processing IoT and sensor data with strict type safety
Needing locale-aware string parsing and formatting for physical quantities
avoid_when: You do not need any measurement or unit conversion logic in your app
strengths: Compile-time type safety preventing invalid arithmetic or unit mixing
Supports 30+ quantity categories including non-linear and logarithmic units
Granular imports to prevent extension method conflicts
weaknesses: Requires learning a specific domain-specific API for quantities and units
